name: NYC yellow taxi trips, January 2024
instructions: Download the Parquet file. Dataset documentation: https://www.nyc.gov/site/tlc/about/tlc-trip-record-data.page

name: Our World in Data CO2 and greenhouse gas emissions
instructions: CSV pinned to commit 22d9a01321ddec951b36f2bfc66e05dc6ad50ad8. Column definitions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owid/co2-data/22d9a01321ddec951b36f2bfc66e05dc6ad50ad8/owid-co2-codebook.csv

name: UCI Online Retail II
instructions: Download and extract the ZIP containing the Excel workbook. Account for both years/sheets. Documentation: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/502/online+retail+ii

name: MovieLens latest small
instructions: Download and extract the ZIP. Its README documents movies, ratings, tags and links. Record the download checksum because this stable URL can change. Documentation: https://grouplens.org/datasets/movielens/latest/

name: OpenFlights airports and routes
instructions: Download both comma-delimited DAT files. They have no header rows. Record checksums because master can change. Column definitions: https://openflights.org/data.php

name: WRI Global Power Plant Database
instructions: Download the CSV of about 35,000 power plants with location, capacity, fuel and generation estimates. Record the checksum because master can change. Documentation: https://datasets.wri.org/dataset/globalpowerplantdatabase

name: Rebrickable LEGO sets and themes
instructions: Download and decompress both gzipped CSVs; sets reference themes by theme_id and themes nest through parent_id. Record checksums because the files are refreshed regularly. Documentation: https://rebrickable.com/downloads/

name: FiveThirtyEight NBA Elo history
instructions: Download the CSV of every NBA and ABA game with pre- and post-game Elo ratings; each game appears once per team. Documentation: https://github.com/fivethirtyeight/data/tree/master/nba-elo

name: NOAA daily weather, New York Central Park
instructions: Download the GHCN-Daily station CSV for Central Park since 1869. Values use GHCN units and flags. Record the checksum because the file grows daily. Documentation: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/land-based-station/global-historical-climatology-network-daily

name: US Census county population estimates 2020-2023
instructions: Download the CSV of county and state population estimates with births, deaths and migration components. Rows with COUNTY 000 are state totals. Documentation: https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/technical-documentation/file-layouts/2020-2023/CO-EST2023-ALLDATA.pdf

name: USGS earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above, 2023
instructions: Download the CSV of every magnitude 4.5+ earthquake in 2023 from the USGS event service; this bounded query is a single response. Documentation: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/data/comcat/data-eventterms.php
